children.text: Car accidents can leave people with serious injuries, expensive property damage, and lots of questions about their options for recovery. While doctors can help repair the physical damage, a lawyer can be helpful in various ways, by helping injured people:
Understand their options for justice and compensation
Protect and advance their interests as they move forward
Financially recover so they can focus on getting better

At Dormer Harpring, we’re dedicated to helping people who’ve been seriously hurt in any type of car or traffic accident. Known for our personal, compassionate service, we are ready to listen to you and provide you with the unique, carefully-tailored representation that can help you obtain a favorable outcome to your case.
How Our Attorneys Can Help You Navigate the Path to Recovery
To help car accident victims build strong cases and support them along the way, a car accident lawyer at Dormer Harpring can:
Obtain and analyze the police report
– This can be key to determining the cause(s) of the accident and, consequently, who’s responsible.
Retain expert witnesses
– tire tread analysts, accident reconstructionists, life care planners, and more. Expert witnesses can back up our clients’ cases, strengthening their claims.
Stand up to insurance companies

– Insurance companies are not generally looking out for accident victims. In fact, insurers may even go to some lengths to try to reduce or deny payouts to victims. An attorney can help fight back to make sure that insurance companies do not get in the way of victims’ rights to compensation.
Compile additional evidence

– This can include (but is by no means limited to) witness testimony, surveillance footage, doctors’ reports, vehicle damage estimates, etc. Such evidence can help establish the value of a claim, aiding victims in securing the full amount of compensation to which they are entitled.
Provide honest advice

– This type of advice can be critical, especially when it’s time to make a decision about how to proceed with a case, whether to accept a settlement offer, etc. It’s important to know and understand both the good news and the bad when making decisions about your case.
Help injured people financially recovery

– Don’t let an auto accident define or limit the rest of your life. With the help of an experienced attorney, your claim can be positioned for success. And that can help you put the crash behind you so you can fully focus on your overall recovery and future.
Aggressive Advocacy Backed by Caring Support
At Dormer Harpring, our attorneys are devoted to more than just vigorous advocacy and successful outcomes. We are also focused on providing:
Personalized legal services

– Our lawyers will listen to your concerns and provide you with responsive, personal service. We will make sure that you are always informed about your case so you can make the best decisions at every crossroads.
Compassion and support
– Our lawyers are not just about winning settlements. We care about our clients’ overall recoveries and futures.
Effective and unique representation in any setting
– We carefully select cases and limit our caseloads so we can fully support our clients both inside and outside of the courtroom.
